label: City of Newport
header:
# City of Newport municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 16; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 007 (City of Newport): section 6 provides for a Mayor elected in city election
City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the City Government roster carries Mayor Rick Ufford-Chase for a term to 2027; the March 2026 warning does not stand the mayor
City of Newport (official website), City Council & Mayor page: lists Rick Ufford-Chase as Mayor

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 007 (City of Newport): section 6 provides for four Aldermen elected in city election; section 7 makes the Mayor and Aldermen the City Council. The city styles its council members 'Council Members'

City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the City Government roster carries Council Members Kevin Charboneau (President; to 2026), John Monette (to 2026), Carter Finegan (to 2027), and Andrew Touchette (to 2027), and the March 2026 warning (Art. 1) stood two council seats for two years
City of Newport (official website), City Council & Mayor page: the post-election council page lists Carter Finegan, John Monette, Andrew Touchette, and Sharon Pare

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): the June 2026 directory's Newport City row names Council President Alissa Finegan, John Monette, Sharon Pare, and Andrew Touchette. Finegan's given name per the directory is Alissa; the report and her city email use her used name, Carter Finegan. Monette, the exp.-2026 incumbent, is recorded re-elected on the two post-election listings. Pare, who appears in the departed Charboneau's place, is NOT recorded: no official source located states how she was seated, so the fourth seat is unfilled here and she is held as a straggler
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 007 (City of Newport): section 6 provides for a City Clerk elected in city election
City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the roster carries James D. Johnson as Clerk/Treasurer for a term to 2028
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 007 (City of Newport): section 6 provides for a City Treasurer elected in city election
City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the roster carries James D. Johnson as Clerk/Treasurer for a term to 2028
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 007 (City of Newport): section 8 provides for a Collector of Taxes appointed by the City Council

City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the Special Appointments column carries Francis Cheney, III as Delinquent Tax Collector (he is also the appointed Tax Assessor); the post is created with an appointed membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 007 (City of Newport): section 6 provides for one Constable elected in city election

City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the March 2026 warning (Art. 1) elects a Constable for one year ensuing, but the report names no constable and no outcome is published in any official source located, so the post is created without a membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 007 (City of Newport): section 6 provides for three Grand Jurors elected in city election

City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the City Government roster prints Grand Jurors Andrew Touchette, Laurie Grimm, and Clark Curtis with terms to 2027, but the March 2026 warning (Art. 1) in the same report stands three Grand Jurors for three years ensuing; the seats stood with no published outcome, so the post is created without memberships and the three roster names are held as stragglers (Touchette is recorded as Alderman)

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five City of Newport justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024; the city report's justice list names four, omitting Carl King, and the listing governs

jp_election.name: City of Newport Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five City of Newport justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Ruth Ann Fletcher, Carl King, Pamela Ladds, Stephen Laurie, and Jacques Roberge. The city's 2025 annual report justice list names four of them (omitting Carl King) and spells 'Pam Ladds' and 'Steven Laurie'; the listing's forms govern. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
City of Newport, 2025 Annual Report: the justice of the peace list names Ruth Ann Fletcher, Pam Ladds, Steven Laurie, and Jacques Roberge
